senses.gloss: मल्ला mallā, f. N..
माल्ल mālla, m. a mixed caste.
मालय 1. māla-ya, den. wreathe.

मालय 2. mālaya, a. coming from the Malaya 🞄range;
 n. caravanserai.
मलिनय malina-ya, den. P. soil, stain, sully 🞄(also fig.): pp. ita, soiled.

मलिनिमन् malin-i-man, m. blackness;
 🞄baseness, wickedness.
मलूक mal-ūka, m. kind of worm.

मल्लारि malla‿ari, m. foe of the Asura Malla, 🞄ep. of Kṛṣṇa and of Śiva;
 -asura, m. 🞄the Asura Malla.

मल्लिका mall-ikā, f. kind of jasmine (Jasminum 🞄Sambac: both flower and plant);
 🞄earthen vessel of a particular shape (Pr.).

मल्लिनाथ malli-nātha, m. N. of a poet and 🞄celebrated commentator (prob. fourteenth or 🞄fifteenth century), called Kolācala, who wrote 🞄commentaries on Kālidāsaʼs three works 🞄Raghuvaṃśa, Kumārasaṃbhava, and Meghadūta, 🞄as well as the Kirātārjunīya and 🞄Śisupālavadha.
मल्व malvá, a. thoughtless, foolish (AV.).
मालभारिन् māla-bhārin, a. wearing a 🞄wreath of (—˚).
मालविका mālav-ikā, f. N.: -agnimitra, 🞄n. Mālavikā and Agnimitra (names of the 🞄heroine and hero), T. of a play attributed to 🞄Kālidāsa.

मालवी mālav-ī, f. princess of Mālava;
 🞄-īya, a. coming from Mālava.

मालु māl-u, m. a mixed caste;
 f. a creeper: 🞄-dhāna, m. kind of animal: ī, f. a creeper.
मालूर māl-ūra, m. a plant.

मालोपमा mālā‿upamā, f. compound simile 🞄(in which an object is compared with several 🞄others instead of with one only) or concatenated 🞄simile (e. g. ‘as heat on the sun, as the 🞄sun on the day, and as the day on the sky, so 🞄has valour conferred lustre on thee’).
